app_tagline: Keeps your *arr libraries complete without hammering your indexers.
connections_description: Integrations and external services connected to SnatchArr.
connections_download_clients_desc: Manage download clients and monitor queue handoff.
connections_seerr_desc: Inspect Seerr media requests and synchronization status.
connections_prowlarr_desc: Monitor indexer health, query limits, and grab headroom.
connections_configarr_desc: Review Configarr sync status and declarative instance definitions.
empty_instances: No instances yet. Add one or import them from Configarr or Seerr.
setup_intro: SnatchArr has no users yet. This account becomes the administrator.
login_sso_failed: Single sign-on failed. Please try again or sign in with your username and password.
instance_legacy_hint: Readarr was retired by its maintainers in June 2025. Existing installs keep working as they do today; SnatchArr adds no new Readarr features.
instance_probe_unknown: {app} {version} answered. It is neither Readarr nor a fork SnatchArr knows.
policy_missing_per_cycle_hint: Number of missing library items to search for in each snatch cycle (0 to disable).
policy_upgrade_per_cycle_hint: Number of cutoff-unmet items to search for quality upgrades in each cycle (0 to disable).
policy_cycle_interval_hint: Time to wait between search cycles of the same kind (refractory cooldown period).
policy_hourly_cap_hint: Maximum indexer searches this instance may send per hour before resting (indexer stamina limit).
policy_selection_hint: How items are chosen from the library during each cycle.
policy_selection_random_hint: Spreads searches randomly across the library.
policy_selection_sequential_hint: Walks through the library in order with a persistent cursor.
policy_selection_recent_hint: Prefers newer releases while reserving a slice for the backlog.
policy_processed_ttl_hint: Hours an item rests after a search before it may be searched again (afterglow period).
policy_afterglow_max_hint: Cooldown doubles after every fruitless search up to this maximum limit (afterglow cap).
policy_recent_grab_window_hint: Skip items grabbed within this many hours to prevent duplicate downloads (0 checks active queue only).
policy_monitored_only_hint: Only search for items marked as monitored in the library.
policy_skip_future_hint: Ignore items with an announced release or air date in the future.
policy_await_command_hint: Wait for the *arr search command to finish before dispatching the next batch.
policy_max_queue_size: Maximum download queue size (-1 for unlimited)
policy_max_queue_size_hint: Pauses new searches when the download client queue reaches this size (-1 for no limit).
policy_page_size_hint: Number of candidate items fetched from *arr per page during evaluation.
policy_release_delay_hint: Hours to wait after an item's release date before searching for it (0 to search immediately).
policy_skip_unavailable_hint: Leaves out movies Radarr does not yet count as available under their minimum availability.
policy_radarr_release_type_hint: Which release date to use for availability and release delay filtering in Radarr.
policy_sonarr_missing_mode_hint: Whether Sonarr searches for missing items as individual episodes, season packs, or entire shows.
policy_sonarr_upgrade_mode_hint: Whether Sonarr searches for cutoff-unmet upgrades as individual episodes or season packs.
policy_lidarr_missing_mode_hint: Whether Lidarr searches for missing music by artist or by album. Upgrade searches always run per album.
policy_group_search_desc: Configure target items, monitoring status, and release filters.
policy_group_timing_desc: Configure cycle intervals, cooldowns, and retry backoff.
policy_group_limits_desc: Protect indexers with stamina caps, queue limits, and page sizes.
policy_group_filters_desc: Filter searches by tags and quality profiles.
policy_group_app_specific_desc: Search granularity and release dates tailored to this application.
policy_group_safety_desc: Test and preview search behavior safely.
policy_presets_hint: Apply a starting preset. Changes are not saved until you submit the form.
preset_gentle_desc: Low search volume (1 missing, 0 upgrades, every 15 min, cap 4 per hour)
preset_balanced_desc: The default: steady searches (2 missing, 1 upgrade, every 15 min, cap 15 per hour)
preset_catch_up_desc: Work through a large backlog in library order (10 missing, 2 upgrades, every 5 min, cap 60 per hour)
preset_upgrades_desc: Prioritizes cutoff-unmet upgrades (1 missing, 5 upgrades, every 10 min, cap 25 per hour)
policy_filters_hint: An empty list does not filter. Hold Ctrl (Cmd on a Mac) to pick several entries.
policy_include_tags: Only items with one of these tags
policy_include_tags_hint: Only search items that carry at least one of these tags (empty allows all).
policy_exclude_tags_hint: Never search items that carry any of these tags.
policy_include_profiles: Only items with one of these quality profiles
policy_include_profiles_hint: Only search items using one of these profiles (empty allows all).
policy_exclude_profiles: Never items with these quality profiles
policy_exclude_profiles_hint: Never search items using any of these quality profiles.
policy_dry_run_hint: Scheduled runs for this instance only preview their targets and never search.
queue_rule_not_an_upgrade: Not an upgrade over the file on disk
queue_policy_grace_hint: Minutes before a stalled or slow download receives its first strike.
queue_policy_min_bps_hint: Downloads slower than this rate after the grace period are considered slow.
queue_policy_min_cfs_hint: Leave empty to disable format score checks.
queue_policy_max_removals_hint: Maximum number of downloads removed in a single queue sweep (1-100).
queue_policy_max_imports_hint: Maximum number of matched imports triggered in a single sweep (1-100).
queue_policy_match_fixable_hint: Minimum match percentage for fixable manual imports (0-100%).
queue_policy_match_broken_hint: Match percentage below which an import is considered broken (0-100%).
queue_policy_track_fixable_hint: Minimum track match percentage for fixable manual imports (0-100%).
queue_policy_track_broken_hint: Track match percentage below which a release is treated as broken (0-100%).
live_empty_desc: Real-time activity from snatch runs, indexer searches, and queue actions appears here as it happens.
live_backlog_error: Failed to load recent event history. Live stream remains active.
schedules_empty: No schedules. Snatching runs around the clock.
dlclients_empty: No download clients. Discover them from an instance or add one.
seerr_empty: No open requests. Either nobody wants anything or no Seerr link is configured.
settings_retention_hint: Number of days to keep historical snatch run records before purging.
settings_user_agent_hint: Custom User-Agent header sent with outbound requests to indexers and *arr apps.
settings_global_cap_hint: Shared search stamina limit across all instances; 0 disables the global limit.
setup_secret_help: Bootstrap secret required by this SnatchArr instance.
notifications_empty_channels: No channels configured. Add a channel to receive notifications.
notifications_empty_rules: No rules configured. Add a rule to trigger notifications.
channel_apprise_url_hint: The stateful endpoint, ending in /notify/ and your configuration key. The key grants sending, so it is stored as a secret.
channel_tags_hint: Comma-separated. A destination with any of these tags receives the message; empty sends to all untagged ones.
password_changed_sessions_ended: Password changed. All other sessions have been ended.
api_key_secret_warning: Copy this key now. You will not be able to see it again.
api_key_revoke_confirm_prompt: Revoke API key "{name}"? Any automation using this key will immediately lose access.
instance_api_key_keep: Leave empty to keep the stored key.
instance_configarr_readonly: Configarr manages this instance, so its connection is read-only here. Change it in the Configarr configuration; only the snatch policy can be edited in SnatchArr.
run_cancel_confirm: Cancel this {kind} run? It stops searching; what it already searched stays searched.
preview_empty: Nothing would be searched now (no wanted item or no stamina left).
memory_reset_all: Reset processed memory of all instances
memory_reset_one_confirm: Forget every item SnatchArr has already searched on {name}, for missing and upgrade snatches alike? The next snatches search all of them again.
memory_reset_all_confirm: Forget every item SnatchArr has already searched on every instance, for missing and upgrade snatches alike? The next snatches search all of them again.
secret_new_hint: Write-only: stored encrypted and never shown again.
secret_keep_hint: Write-only. Leave empty to keep the stored value.
seerr_links_empty: No Seerr link yet. Add one below.
prowlarr_readonly_hint: SnatchArr only reads from Prowlarr; it never changes anything there.
prowlarr_links_empty: No Prowlarr link yet. Add one below.
configarr_not_linked: Not linked. Set APP_SNATCHARR_CONFIGARR_CONFIG to keep instances in sync, or import once below.
configarr_watching: Watching the files for changes every 30 s
configarr_not_watching: Not watching the files for changes
configarr_import_hint: Paths on the API host. Leave the config file empty to re-import the linked configuration.
logs_redacted_note: Secrets are replaced with [REDACTED] before a record is kept.
logs_window: Newest {shown} records; the server keeps {capacity}, {dropped} older ones were overwritten.
logs_admin_only: Only administrators can read the logs.
instance_not_found_text: This instance does not exist or has been deleted.
settings_priority_presets_hint: Default search and download ranks per application kind (1–100, lower numbers run first).
instance_priority_hint: Optional search and download rank overrides (1–100, lower numbers run first). Leave empty to follow the preset.
